boundary.governing_question: Which consequential effects remained inside a declared authority boundary?
boundary.primary_invariant: No unauthorized consequential side effect may occur inside the declared and confirmed observation scope.
in_scope: Observed effects across instrumented stores, tools, queues, disclosures, and downstream agents
Prevention, detection, receipt accuracy, mutation activation, and preserved authorized usefulness
out_of_scope: Real-world legitimacy of an authority declaration
Complete observation of uninstrumented external systems
Production safety or universal agent conformance

provides.description: A report separating behavioral conformance, side-effect evidence, receipt accuracy, and mutation-kill results.

claims: The deterministic reference harness can evaluate declared authority boundaries inside its synthetic observation scope.
does_not_claim: That an upstream readout is true
That declared authority is legitimate in the real world
That a passing synthetic result proves production safety
That this system grants authority to another system

ip_boundary.public_basis: Observable permissions, attempted operations, consequential effects, observation coverage, and receipts.
excluded: Private correspondence, identities, and sealed cases
